question: How are the outer enclosures arranged and where is the teacher placed in alternative layouts?
premises: Outside there are three enclosures extending in order up to the pledged initiates.
All participants may instead be arranged in rows.
In every arrangement the teacher remains in the middle.
inference: Whether arranged in concentric enclosures or in rows, the assembly is ordered hierarchically with the teacher always at the center.
uncertainties: The exact grades included between the inner group and the samayin are not named here.
plain_english: Outside there are three enclosures in due order, extending up to the pledged initiates; or all may be arranged in rows, but in every case the teacher is always in the middle.
